instructions: Enforce project-specific review guidelines - see docs/review-guidelines.md for complete checklist

rules.rule: Package dependencies must follow core → hooks → ui dependency order
Always use workspace:* protocol for internal dependencies
Schema-first: All types defined in schemas/*.ts using Zod
Unified versioning: All packages must maintain exact same version. This change will happen automatically any time a single package is updated via changeset.
Zero React: Pure TypeScript, no React dependencies
Context and Provider in separate files, exported via context/index.ts
Auto-injected styles: index.ts calls injectStyles() on module load

files.description: Comprehensive review checklist for all pull requests
